title: Daniel Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Daniel 11: the kings of the south and the north, the contemptible person, and the king who exalts himself.

questions.text: In the first year of which ruler does the speaker say he stood up to confirm and strengthen him?
questions.explanation: The speaker says that in the first year of Darius the Mede he stood up to confirm and strengthen him.

answers.text: Darius the Mede
Cyrus the Persian
Nebuchadnezzar the king
Belshazzar his son

questions.text: What does the text say about the fourth king who will stand up in Persia?
questions.explanation: The text says the fourth will be far richer than all of them, and that when he has grown strong through his riches he will stir up all against the realm of Greece.

answers.text: He will be the wisest of them all
He will build a new city for himself
He will be far richer than all of them
He will be killed by his own princes

questions.text: When the mighty king stands up, toward what will his kingdom be divided?
questions.explanation: The text says his kingdom will be broken and divided toward the four winds of the sky, but not to his posterity.

answers.text: Toward his four sons
Toward the four winds of the sky
Toward the two great rivers
Toward the islands of the sea

questions.text: Into which land will he carry the captured gods, molten images and vessels of silver and gold?
questions.explanation: The text says he will carry their gods, their molten images and their goodly vessels of silver and gold captive into Egypt.

answers.text: Into Babylon
Into Persia
Into Greece
Into Egypt

questions.text: How does the contemptible person obtain the kingdom?
questions.explanation: The text says he comes in a time of security and obtains the kingdom by flatteries, although the honor of the kingdom had not been given to him.

answers.text: By flatteries
By open battle
By inheritance from his father
By the choice of the priests

questions.text: Ships of whom will come against him, so that he is grieved and returns?
questions.explanation: The text says ships of Kittim will come against him, and therefore he will be grieved and return and have indignation against the holy covenant.

answers.text: Ships of Tyre
Ships of Egypt
Ships of Kittim
Ships of the king of the south

questions.text: What will be set up after the continual burnt offering is taken away?
questions.explanation: The text says forces will profane the sanctuary, take away the continual burnt offering, and then set up the abomination that makes desolate.

answers.text: An image of gold in the plain
A throne of ivory and silver
A great altar of foreign stone
The abomination that makes desolate

questions.text: What will those who are wise among the people do, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The text says those who are wise among the people will instruct many, yet they will fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder.

answers.text: They will flee to the mountains
They will instruct many
They will seal up the vision
They will rule over many nations

questions.text: Which three are named as delivered out of his hand when he enters the glorious land?
questions.explanation: The text says many countries will be overthrown, but Edom, Moab and the chief of the children of Ammon will be delivered out of his hand.

answers.text: Edom, Moab and the chief of the children of Ammon
Egypt, Libya and the land of the Ethiopians
Tyre, Sidon and the islands of the sea
Judah, Benjamin and the land of Gilead

questions.text: Where will he plant the tents of his palace before he comes to his end?
questions.explanation: The text says he will plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain, yet he will come to his end with no one to help him.

answers.text: In the valley of the king of the south
On the islands that he had taken
Between the sea and the glorious holy mountain
Beside the great river of his own land
